title: Draft local-first fleet operations model
verified: Fleet model is explicitly preview-only and not a GA fleet manager, remote command plane or production rollout authority.
Single-node local proof remains complete without network, external LLM, Firecracker, host package manager, remote registry, remote audit mirror or hosted control plane.
Remote commands cannot bypass local AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine; future remote requests must enter as local intents and be evaluated locally.
Rollout expectations require local PlanRun, exact approval, inactive-slot or inert staging, health checks, SecurityExecutionEngine commit and rollback evidence.
Rollback ownership is local-first and remote orchestration cannot directly mutate nodes.
risk_notes: Fleet concepts remain projection/design-only in Console Beta.
TUI does not become remote rollout authority.
Production rollout remains blocked on future RC0 evidence, production signatures, rollout rollback drills and node-level audit evidence.
